iti101:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā, vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti101:2.1: cattārimāni bhikkhave appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjāni.
iti101:2.3: paṃsukūlaṃ bhikkhave cīvarānaṃ appaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca tañca anavajjaṃ.
iti101:2.4: piṇḍiyālopo bhikkhave bhojanānaṃ appañca sulabhañca tañca anavajjaṃ.
iti101:2.5: rukkhamūlaṃ bhikkhave senāsanānaṃ appaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca tañca anavajjaṃ.
iti101:2.6: pūtimuttaṃ bhikkhave bhesajjānaṃ appaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca tañca anavajjaṃ.
iti101:2.7: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjāni.
iti101:2.8: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu appena ca tuṭṭho hoti sulabhena ca. imassāhaṃ aññataraṃ sāmaññaṅganti vadāmī’ti.
iti101:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
